Prepare daily modifiers for simulation

Source: R/epicrop_sim.R
dot-prepare_modifiers.Rd

Interpolates and calculates all daily modifier values needed for disease progression simulation, including age, temperature, wetness, and other crop-specific parameters.

Usage

.prepare_modifiers(
  w,
  age_vec,
  duration,
  RcA,
  RcT,
  RcW,
  RcOpt,
  p,
  i,
  RRS,
  a,
  RRLEX,
  RRG,
  rhlim,
  rainlim,
  simple_wetness
)

Arguments

w

A data.tablecontaining weather data with TEMP, RHUM, and RAIN columns.

age_vec

Numeric vector of crop ages (in days or physiological time).

duration

Integer. Total number of simulation days.

RcA

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the age correction factor.

RcT

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the temperature correction factor.

RcW

Numeric vector, data.frame, or NULL defining the wetness correction factor. If NULL and not using simple_wetness, linear scaling is applied.

RcOpt

Numeric scalar. Optimal infection rate.

p

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the probability of successful infection.

i

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the infection efficiency.

RRS

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the relative rate of senescence.

a

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the aggregation parameter.

RRLEX

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the relative rate of latent expansion.

RRG

Numeric vector or data.frame defining the relative rate of growth.

rhlim

Numeric scalar. Relative humidity threshold (%) for leaf wetness.

rainlim

Numeric scalar. Rainfall threshold (mm) for leaf wetness.

simple_wetness

Logical. If TRUE, use binary wetness (wet/dry). If FALSE, calculate hourly leaf wetness duration.

Value

A named list containing interpolated daily values:

  • Rc - Combined correction factor (RcOpt * RcA * RcT * RcW)

  • RRLEX - Relative rate of latent expansion

  • RRG - Relative rate of growth

  • RRS - Relative rate of senescence

  • p - Probability of successful infection

  • i - Infection efficiency

  • a - Aggregation parameter

Details

For simple wetness, a day is considered wet if either:

  • Relative humidity >= rhlim, OR

  • Rainfall >= rainlim

For complex wetness, hourly leaf wetness duration is calculated and either interpolated using RcW or linearly scaled (0-24 hours -> 0-1).
